text: 国家统计局：生猪产能综合调控政策效应显现，叠加部分地区高温、强降雨等极端天气频发推高运输成本等因素，猪肉价格由上月环比下降0.8%转为上涨4.1%，影响CPI环比上涨约0.07个百
text_en: National Bureau of Statistics: The effects of comprehensive policy regulation of hog production capacity are emerging, combined with factors such as extreme weather like high temperatures and heavy rainfall in some regions pushing up transport costs, pork prices turned from a 0.8% month-on-month decline last month to a 4.1% increase, contributing about 0.07 percentage points to the month-on-month CPI change
